metadata.title: Automate your operation with AI agents
metadata.description: Aurora answers questions, handles paperwork and automates collections with AI agents. Less operational load and decisions in real time.

footer.tagline: Conversational AI agents that support customers, handle paperwork and automate collections, connected to the systems you already use.

customerService.title: Powering customer service
customerService.description: Aurora deploys conversational AI agents to answer questions, escalate requests and automate processes. Leading the era of collaborative work with AI — everything that used to take a full team now happens in a single conversation.

panel.title: One single experience
panel.description: From custom agent modules and knowledge base integrations to workflow design, connect your existing tools with ease and oversee your entire hybrid workforce—AI and human—in one place.
panel.imageAlt: Aurora dashboard showing customer service metrics

control.title: Full control
control.description: The business defines and manages the knowledge and the tools available to each agent.
control.imageAlt: An Aurora agent looking up documents and an API to reply over WhatsApp

growth.title: Turn conversations into business growth
growth.description: Cut operating costs, remove repetitive tasks and let your team focus on high-impact initiatives.

customerCare.title: Customer service
customerCare.description: Set your agent's tone and style to answer questions instantly on any channel, securely and in real time.
customerCare.imageAlt: A person chats from their phone with an Aurora agent that verifies their identity

pqrs.title: Requests and complaints
pqrs.description: Handle requests, complaints and claims end to end: gather details in a single chat, apply security filters, notify the user of updates and measure historical performance.
pqrs.imageAlt: An Aurora agent files a claim and returns the case number and resolution deadline

workflows.title: Drive end-to-end workflow automation
workflows.description: Build specialised AI agents configured to your company's requirements and give every department an intelligent collaborative team.

schedule.title: Smart scheduling
schedule.description: Books appointments autonomously, sends automatic reminders, syncs with your calendars and reshuffles your team's availability in real time to remove friction.
schedule.imageAlt: An Aurora agent offers available days and time slots and confirms an appointment

certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.description: Lets your customers download certificates and important documents on their own in seconds, with no manual paperwork or branch visits.
certificates.imageAlt: An Aurora agent pulls data from the business system and generates a downloadable membership certificate

procedures.title: Paperwork
procedures.description: Automates paperwork end to end: the AI agent validates documents, cross-checks information, handles corrections and sends the data to third-party systems, with no agents involved and no manual data entry.
procedures.imageAlt: An Aurora agent verifies the user, validates the required documents and files the request

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Automates collections with AI: sends personalised reminders and generates secure payment links, following the policies and timings your company defines.
collections.imageAlt: Collections dashboard with recovered revenue, promise-to-pay rate and a payment reminder sent by the agent

marketing.title: Marketing, Acquisition & Automated Sales
marketing.description: Accelerate business growth by automating the entire sales funnel through a single conversation.

campaigns.title: Marketing
campaigns.description: Launch automated mass messages aimed at sales conversion or strategic communication with your segmented audiences.
campaigns.imageAlt: An Aurora agent sends a vacation promotion with a downloadable brochure and the customer replies with interest

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Automate prospecting by letting AI maintain a fluid conversation with the customer until detecting the exact moment for the sale.
leads.imageAlt: Aurora detects interest in the offer and logs the lead as classified, with an audience and an advisor assigned

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: Manage personalized purchase flows via chat—from product selection and payment to automatic integration with your store for immediate dispatch.
sales.imageAlt: Purchase tracking over WhatsApp with the cart created, the order ready and the shipment pending confirmation

insights.title: Raise your AI's performance with intelligent insight
insights.description: AI conversations monitored end to end for real-time business decisions.

testing.title: Testing and statistics
testing.description: Test your flows with real customers, measure how satisfied they are and spot opportunities to improve straight away
testing.imageAlt: Conversation quality panel with grounded knowledge, fast response and full resolution all checked

costs.title: Cost reduction
costs.description: See the direct impact on cost reduction

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Measure the quality of interactions and answers per agent

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Measure success rates and customer service metrics to optimise workflows in real time.
analytics.activityAlt: Chart of agent activity per day
analytics.interestsAlt: Top user interests: payment management, documents and technical support

data.title: The data is already yours, Aurora puts it to work
data.description: We pull verified data from your core systems via API to build custom calls for every operational need. Automate the heavy lifting and let your team focus on what matters most.
data.imageAlt: Aurora connected by API to two code snippets importing its responses and knowledge libraries

closingCta.title: Discover how AI agents transform communications and drive growth in real time.

exploreAurora.title: Explore Aurora
exploreAurora.subtitle: Automate the operation. Free up your talent. Grow the business.
